messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout to prod region `us-west-2` finished at 2026-03-15T14:20:23Z. Telemetry: 5xx spike on /v1/prompt-route, error rate 9.8% over baseline, latency p95 up 3.2x. Dashboard https://dash.redwood.example/c/rollouts/2090011223 :deploy: 
Mia R.: seeing user sessions failing in logs, a lot of `InvalidResponse` from experimental route. paging Sam now.
Sam J. (on-call): on it. pulling logs + tailing canary pods. can you paste the canary tag and FF key?
Mia R.: canary tag `router-exp-v3-canary`. feature flag key `router.experimental_route_enabled`. Error traces point to new endpoint `prompt-v2-route` returning truncated responses.
Alex P.: also noticing increased retries in client library, appears to be a mix of 500s and 502s. Affected customers: subset of PLG traffic hitting the new route.
LZ (support): support queue shows ~45 recent tickets complaining about timeouts for prompt completions. No major enterprise customers affected yet, mostly free-tier and prod-testers.
Sam J. (on-call): ok let's do emergency fallback: disable flag for 100% traffic. calling the feature-flag service now. executing:`curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/flags/router.experimental_route_enabled/toggle -d '{"enabled":false,"actor":"oncall","reason":"canary failures"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${ONCALL_TOKEN}'`
opsbot: Received toggle request, validating...
opsbot: Feature flag router.experimental_route_enabled set to false by Sam J. (on-call). Propagation to edge caches ~10–30s.
Mia R.: confirming client traces show traffic diverted back to legacy route. error-rate dropping on the dashboard.
deploy-bot: Canary pods `router-exp-v3-canary` marked for drain after 30s. Scaling down 4 -> 0.
Sam J. (on-call): rolling back canary containers as well: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/router-exp -n prod --to-revision=14`
Alex P.: after rollback and FF flip, p95 latency back to normal in us-west-2. 5xxs trending down to baseline. good sign.
incident-manager: nice quick mitigation. can someone capture a short customer impact assessment for the postmortem? need counts, affected endpoints, and duration of impact.
Mia R.: impact window: 14:20:23Z - 14:26:05Z (approx) while FF was propagating and canary draining. peak error rate ~9.8%, estimated ~3.1k requests failed. primary endpoint /v1/prompt-route via prompt-v2-route. regions: US-West only.
LZ (support): queued ~47 tickets; initial AC count sent to CS: 12 customers reported significant failures, no escalations yet.
Sam J. (on-call): summary for handoff: Mitigation actions done — 1) FF toggle disabled experimental routing, 2) canary pods drained and rollback invoked, 3) monitoring rerouted to legacy metric set. No further rollback required.
Mia R.: next steps: capture logs for failing requests and compare with canary-specific transformations (prompt truncation logic). Also run local replay to reproduce. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
Alex P.: adding tests to catch truncated completions in the integration suite. will instrument a canary-specific alert to trigger earlier next time.
incident-manager: setting severity to Sev3. creating incident ticket INC-2026-2090011223 with initial notes. Please add timeline and attach logs.
Sam J. (on-call): I'll remain on the thread for handoff to the next oncall in 2h. If anything oscillates, re-open page.
Mia R.: thanks — good catch everyone. for the postmortem let's capture the propagation delay assumptions for FF invalidation; looks like edge cache TTLs prolonged the effective impact window.
opsbot: Reminder — create a retrospective and link the rollback/playbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/ops/ff-rollbacks
Alex P.: will draft a short write-up and include the curl command and kubectl steps used so oncall runbook is up-to-date.
LZ (support): I'll follow up with affected customers and flag any enterprise escalations.
incident-manager: closing thread for now; move discussion to /#postmortems when initial write-up is ready. :white_check_mark:
